test_title: PYST 27: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 23 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
'A + B' means 'A is the father of B'

'A - B' means 'A is the wife of B'

'A × B' means 'A is the brother of B'

'A ÷ B' means 'A is the daughter of B'

If 'P - R × Q + S', then which of the following statements is true?

options.text: P is the sister-in-law of R.
P is the sister-in-law of Q.
Q is the sister-in-law of P.
P is the sister-in-law of S.

solution:
Preparing the family tree diagram by using the following symbols:

**Given expression:** 'P - R × Q + S'

P is the wife of R, R is the brother of Q and Q is the father of S.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ccc9bacf9ea6b58f9232fd277b3fd1990005917a3fc530d2c5d38dda04bccfa.png] 

Checking all the given options:

(1) P is the sister-in-law of R. → Incorrect

(2) P is the sister-in-law of Q. → **Correct**

(3) Q is the sister-in-law of P. → Incorrect

(4) P is the sister-in-law of S. → Incorrect

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (2)".
